subject: Full-loop scheduling: Alex Tan (SWE) — staggered waves and debrief ownership
messages:
From: TalentFlow Recruiting <recruiting@talentflow.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Full-loop for Alex Tan (SWE) — initial availability

Hi Karthik and Marissa,

Quick intro — I recruit for Alex Tan (resume attached). He’s excited about the SWE role. He’s available for a virtual onsite the week of April 6. A couple of options to start the conversation: 

- Option A (single day, denser): Apr 6 (Mon) 10:00–15:30 PT with two short breaks (4x 50m panels + 30m hiring manager)
- Option B (staggered waves): Apr 6 (Mon) 13:00–17:00 PT + Apr 7 (Tue) 09:00–11:00 PT (reduces continuous blocks for APAC panelists)
- Option C (two half-days): Apr 6 (Mon) 12:00–16:00 PT and Apr 8 (Wed) 09:00–11:30 PT

Can you confirm which pattern works best for your teams? Also: 1) any preference for who owns the debrief? 2) do you want us to pre-send a short prep pack and invite links?

Resume: AlexTan_Resume.pdf (attached)

Thanks,
Jill Park
TalentFlow Recruiting
recruiting@talentflow.io

--
Attachment: AlexTan_Resume.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: TalentFlow Recruiting <recruiting@talentflow.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Full-loop for Alex Tan (SWE) — initial availability

Thanks Jill — and welcome Alex (cc’ed) if you’re reading.

Staggered waves (Option B) is preferred here — it better preserves interviewer focus and reduces fatigue. Our suggested concrete schedule for April 6/7:

- Wave 1 (US West-friendly): Apr 6, 13:00–15:00 PT
  - 13:00–13:50 Technical deep dive (engineer panel)
  - 14:00–14:50 System design (senior eng)

- Wave 2 (HM + cross-functional): Apr 6, 15:30–17:00 PT
  - 15:30–16:00 Hiring manager (HM)
  - 16:10–16:40 PM/OKR & product sense (PM/CrossFunc)

- Async follow-up / buffer: Apr 7, 09:00–10:30 PT
  - Additional pairing/test or overflow if discussions run long; debrief to be scheduled 30–60m after last interviewer.

Laura — would you be able to own the debrief coordination and final feedback collection? Also tagging Soojin to confirm you can be the single feedback aggregator so we can avoid multiple forms.

If Alex prefers a single day, we can compress but will need to reduce panel length to 40m each. Please confirm timezone for Alex.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Eng Manager — Hiring Coordinator
Redwood Inference

From: TalentFlow Recruiting <recruiting@talentflow.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-04T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Full-loop for Alex Tan (SWE) — initial availability

Thanks Karthik — Alex confirms he’s based in Pacific Time (San Francisco) and prefers afternoon slots. Option B (staggered waves) works for him — he’d like the bulk of interviews on Apr 6 if possible. He asked for a short prep doc and a heads-up on the system design prompt (can be high-level).

I will share the candidate prep pack and calendar invites once you confirm final times and debrief owner.

Cheers,
Jill
TalentFlow Recruiting

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: TalentFlow Recruiting <recruiting@talentflow.io>
Date: 2028-04-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Plan: Staggered-wave schedule + debrief owner (final proposal)

Following up with a concrete runbook — finalizing times so Jill can send invites and the prep pack. Attachments: candidate-prep-pack.pdf (brief for Alex), slot-grid.xlsx (internal schedule).

Proposed final schedule (all PT):

Apr 6 (Mon) — Wave A (US West-friendly)
- 13:00–13:50 — Technical panel (Karthik, Marcus Lin) — panel focus: alg/data structures, code review
- 14:00–14:50 — System design (Senior Eng) (Marissa Cole) — prompt: scale a streaming KV cache

Break 30m

- 15:30–16:00 — Hiring manager (Laura Bennett) — ownership & team fit
- 16:10–16:40 — PM/Cross-functional (So that product sense is covered) (Soojin Lee)

Apr 7 (Tue) — Overflow / pairing / quick coding check
- 09:00–10:30 — Pairing exercise or extra time if any panel needs to extend

Debrief: 17:30 PT on Apr 6 — Owner: Laura Bennett (I’ll gather feedback via the shared form, consolidate notes, and post summary to the hiring drive).

Notes and asks:
- Please keep interviews to the specified windows; we’ll use rolling calendar invites with Zoom links in the prep pack.
- Soojin — can you commit to being the feedback aggregator if Laura needs help? We’d prefer a single collector to reduce duplicate forms.
- Marissa — please prepare the system design prompt (high-level) and confirm whiteboard link.

Attachments: candidate-prep-pack.pdf, slot-grid.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll send calendar invites after Jill confirms candidate availability.

Laura Bennett
Director, Eng — Hiring Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Full-loop scheduling: Alex Tan (SWE) — staggered waves and debrief ownership

All set — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Confirming final plan:

- Candidate: Alex Tan (alex.tan@gmail.com) — Apr 6 main wave; Apr 7 reserved as overflow.
- Debrief owner: Laura Bennett (post-debrief summary to hiring drive).
- Feedback aggregator: Soojin Lee will collect raw feedback in the shared form; Laura will consolidate.
- Prep pack & invites: Jill to send to candidate and calendar attendees with Zoom links (please cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com).

Operational notes:
- Marissa: please upload the system design prompt to the drive link below so Alex can see the high-level area in advance. Keep specifics vague to preserve the exercise integrity.
- We’ll allow 10–15m buffer between panels; ask interviewers to block an extra 30m for optional async notes.

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/hiring/alex-tan/prep (prep pack + calendar)

Thanks — I’ll run the debrief schedule and stay on standby during the sessions.

Karthik
